title: DocClass
description: The classified genre of a snapshot when it is not mechanically known at collect. One row per (snapshot, workflow), item_key=''. The `corpus` view reads payload->>'doc_type' as the classified half of doc_type_eff = COALESCE(sources.doc_type, doc_class.doc_type) — so `doc_type` is mandatory and its vocabulary must match the mechanical doc_type domain in enums.yaml.

doc_type.description: Genre of the document (enums.yaml doc_type). Feeds doc_type_eff = COALESCE(sources.doc_type, doc_class.doc_type), which annotate scopes filter on (e.g. screen IN ('paper','preprint','eval_report','lab_blog')).

self_published.description: Publisher == subject org (the doc is about its own author's work). Mirrors sources.self_published when that could not be set mechanically.

primary_lang.description: BCP-47 primary language tag of the body, when the classifier reports it.

rationale.description: Why this genre — brief, for audit.
